If you are trying to register a cd-key that has 25 digits (DoD, CZ, or ATI Bundle key), and getting a "The Steam servers are too busy... sorry for the inconvenience" message, please enter the key [b]including[/b] the original dashes, like this:



abcde-12345-fghij-67890-klmno





thanks,



Taylor

Some of you have had this problem and none of the solutions have worked for you.  I'm going to tell you why:



Steam has a rather shortsighted design approach to authentication.  It tries to tie your authentication to your IP address.  When your client PC is using NAT and has direct private access to the HLDS via LAN, you wil NOT be able to connect to your server.
